label: Community building
summary: Community building is one of the core activities Maaike does as a freelancer under Convocat, alongside conversation design. It is characterised as core work, not a side activity. Maaike credits building communities with helping her reshape and redefine the core of her business.
how_maaike_uses: In her two-year reflection on running Convocat, Maaike frames community building as something that emerged as central to her work during the freelance period, particularly in the context of navigating COVID and figuring out what her business actually was. It sits alongside conversation design as the two pillars of what Convocat does, and it seems to have grown out of the same drives she identifies in herself: learning, sharing, and connecting.
open_questions: How exactly did community building help Maaike reshape her core business, and what changed as a result?
What is the relationship between conversation design and community building in her practice — are they treated as separate services or as interconnected?
